verdict.rationale: YPOG publishes substantive briefings on German startup instruments and rules: ESOP taxation under §19a and the Future Financing Act, VSOP alternatives, the German FDI regime and German cap-table particularities. Outside Germany the coverage is thin, limited to a passing mention of UK Advance Subscription Agreements in a European convertibles briefing. Missing for 10: publications on UK EMI schemes, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE or other non-German regimes, and independent corroboration of the publication depth.
